name: Driving harness
definition: the set of harness a horse, pony or donkey wears to draw a vehicle or implement: collar or breastplate, harness saddle, traces, breeching and reins.
reason: Saddlery for any animal (HS 4201); draws a load, so B10.4.1. Page must show a horse driving harness sold as a set.

name: Electronic pet fence
definition: a boundary-wire, wireless or GPS system that keeps a dog or cat inside a set area by signalling a receiver collar it wears.
reason: Pet-only containment is B10 (K-103 as gate, pen); sold for dogs and cats, rule 3.1. Page must show the system sold as one product.

name: Wet cat food
definition: a moist cat food in a can, pouch or tray.
reason: Memo: cat feed classes follow the dog classes (wet dog food B10.1.1.02). Page must show wet cat food sold.

name: Fresh or frozen cat food
definition: a lightly cooked or raw cat food kept chilled or frozen.
reason: Mirrors dog class B10.1.1.03 (memo; Pet Circle form split). Page must show chilled, fresh or frozen cat food sold.

name: Cat treat
definition: a snack fed to a cat apart from its meals; complementary, not a complete diet.
reason: Mirrors dog treat B10.1.1.06; AAFCO separates treats from complete foods. Page must show cat treats sold.
